title: Execution Proposal Approval
description: execution-proposal-approval/v1: the receiver taking a proposed execution as a whole. The verdict is the event type, not a field, because a guard reads types and never payloads. Once a proposal is approved the trade can no longer be cancelled, and the pledger executes the proposed intents.

proposalId.description: The proposal approved. The event also references the proposal event itself.

note.description: Free-text remark. An approval needs no justification.
